fixed_findings.finding: read resolved and checked a pathname, then reopened it; a swapped leaf or ancestor follows a symlink outside the private jail.
fixed_findings.fix: Parent changed read to pinned directory descriptors, leaf O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and fstat regular check. Independent active-boundary race assertions pass.

fixed_findings.finding: If fdopen raises before wrapping staging fd, unlink runs but raw descriptor remains open.
fixed_findings.fix: Register raw fd with ExitStack before fdopen, use closefd=False. Injected wrapper failures prove read/write close their owned descriptor.

fixed_findings.finding: An existing-account registration ceremony rehydrates its owner even when current authenticated user is absent. Logout/revocation does not retire the10minute ceremony, so possession of that cookie/challenge can enroll a new account credential after authentication is removed.
fixed_findings.fix: Existing-account enrollment now requires active matching current user. Cookie owner is never reloaded as substitute for authentication; anonymous registration is preserved by original suite.

fixed_findings.finding: HTTP200 OAuth token responses are parsed without JSON/type validation. Invalid JSON or a JSON list escapes as JSONDecodeError/AttributeError rather than OAuthError; route then returns500 instead of its documented provider502 path. GitHub/Google profile object shape has the same .get assumption.
fixed_findings.fix: Shared provider object decoder converts malformed/non-object token/profile payloads into safe OAuthError; tokens must be nonempty strings.

fixed_findings.finding: Important authentication state transitions and OAuth failure branches emit no semantic audit events, contrary to docs/logging.md. Uvicorn access logs cannot identify account creation, credential enrollment or session revocation.
fixed_findings.fix: Safe account resolution, passkey enrollment, revocation-request and token exchange outcome events added. Requested revocation explicitly remains pending caller commit; no false persisted-state claim.

fixed_findings.finding: The donation becomes active but the customer ID is lost: the handler updates only an already-existing Subscription by its new Stripe subscription ID, while donation checkout never creates that row. customer_id_for still returns None and the existing portal raises NoCustomer, so the donor cannot manage/cancel the recurring donation through the promised account portal.
fixed_findings.fix: Donation owns nullable stripe_customer_id; own-user lookup prefers donations and falls back to legacy Subscription. No manufactured plan rows. Payment-mode SDK parameters explicitly request Customer creation. Reversible migration restores only uniquely bound historical customer IDs without changing user ownership.

fixed_findings.finding: The donation is marked paid/active immediately. checkout.session.async_payment_failed is not handled, so a one-time failed payment remains permanently recorded as paid. This is donation accounting correctness, not a claim that paid access or credits are granted.
fixed_findings.fix: Checkout completion stores IDs but confirms paid/active only for explicit payment_status=paid. Async success uses the same paid-gated handler; async failure keeps once pending or month lapsed. Event-ID claim remains transactional and duplicate deliveries are no-ops.

fixed_findings.finding: The first event stores canceled; the second unconditionally sets active. Event-id deduplication does not protect against these distinct events, so canceled recurring donations become falsely active. No authorization or monetary entitlement escalation is claimed.
fixed_findings.fix: Donation rows are selected FOR UPDATE with populate_existing so preloaded stale identities refresh after lock acquisition. Canceled remains terminal across invoice, checkout and async payment transitions, including overlapping independent sessions.

fixed_findings.finding: Fractional cents persist a different donation amount from the integer cents requested from Stripe (1.999USD versus199cents); sub-cent input reaches zero provider amount.
fixed_findings.fix: Reject nonfinite/nonpositive and fractional-cent amounts through existing InvalidDonationAmount before row insertion or provider invocation. Exact-cent inputs including trailing zeros retain identical amounts.

fixed_findings.finding: A truthy non-list concepts field in a single valid JSON run file raises uncaught TypeError, taking down the aggregate snapshot and all held_by callers, including status/queue/admission, even for valid sibling runs.
fixed_findings.fix: Validate concepts list shape per record before iteration. Reject only malformed run/batch records and retain valid sibling reservations. Emit bounded WARNING source,field,value_type without paths or private bodies. Existing missing/null field behavior remains empty.

fixed_findings.finding: Failed keyword queries consume the free daily query allowance and write success-shaped ledger rows. The real hub reports failure strings at hub/mcp-server/hub_mcp_server.py:327 and371. fixed_findings.fix: call_hub recognizes standard MCP isError and exact legacy ERROR:/nonzero EXIT conventions, returns sanitized isError result; _tools_call rolls back and skips metering. Ordinary text and EXIT0 retain successful metering.

fixed_findings.finding: Both index operations start and succeed although free indexes limit is1. Daily query counters have the same check-then-await structure; exact witness covers free index cap only.
fixed_findings.fix: Lock account User row transactionally before quota read and hold through operation/meter commit. Invalidate index catalogue under lock, including separately cached callers. Roll back failures/cancellation.

fixed_findings.finding: Operators see generic502 without the gateway tool operation or safe failure class. Comments claim chained detail reaches logs, but that catch path never logs.
fixed_findings.fix: Single upstream wrapper boundary emits known bounded operation and exception class (64chars maximum), no args, raw provider text or traceback.

fixed_findings.finding: The semaphore token is held by the awaiting coroutine, not the running hash worker. Coroutine cancellation releases it immediately while the thread continues, allowing actual concurrent Argon2 workers above ARGON2_CONCURRENCY. The advertised process-wide memory bound therefore does not hold under cancellation.
fixed_findings.fix: Keep a permit owned by the running worker until completion. Shield worker lifetime or use a completion callback that releases the permit exactly once and consumes worker exceptions even when waiter is cancelled. Never release while hash remains active.

fixed_findings.finding: The module emits no semantic issuance/revocation audit events despite the documented critical-transition logging policy. Access logs do not identify key lifecycle operations.
fixed_findings.fix: Emit safe key issuance/revocation request events with non-secret key ID/prefix and user ID. Because these helpers flush and caller commits, event wording must not claim persisted commit success. Never include plaintext, secret half or Argon hash.

fixed_findings.finding: Authentication holds its request SELECT connection while optional last-use metadata awaits a second connection. A full shared pool stalls every such request until the pool timeout.
fixed_findings.fix: A central100ms best-effort deadline includes checkout, UPDATE and commit; failure keeps authentication alive and records safe exception class only.

fixed_findings.finding: Read-then-create cannot lock an absent credit row; simultaneous first spends collide. SELECT FOR UPDATE also retains an already-loaded ORM Credit balance unless refreshed; Python subtraction can silently overwrite an intervening debit, breaking ledger/credit consistency.
fixed_findings.fix: PostgreSQL INSERT ON CONFLICT UPDATE uses current database balance minus exact money(amount), sets updated_at and returns refreshed Credit with populate_existing.

fixed_findings.finding: Ledger writes emit no semantic event although docs/logging.md explicitly requires critical ledger transitions be logged.
fixed_findings.fix: Safe INFO ledger_append_staged after flush with ledger/user IDs, bounded component/kind, units and billable flag; no raw call,IP,email or transaction commit claim.

fixed_findings.finding: Public tree publication precedes the durable moderation decision and has no rollback/recovery coordination with the caller-owned database transaction.

residual_findings.trigger: A valid run-scoped API key with max_usd_day=0 calls hub_index_docset for an account on the free plan with zero owned indexes, zero credit and overage_opt_in=False.
residual_findings.observed: The actual free-plan indexes quota admits the call. Gateway.handle reaches the fake hub and returns HTTP 200. Actual ledger.record/_debit_credit generate a $0.100000 debit for the reported 1000000 embedding units. The fake DB reflecting that actual INSERT ends at -$0.100000. The staged LedgerEntry has api_key_id=None and client_ip=None.
residual_findings.consequence: The caller can spend service-funded indexing resources despite both configured stop conditions. Missing key attribution prevents a daily key-spend total from accounting for these rows.
residual_findings.repair: Apply account/key budget admission before billable hub work under the existing account lock, and forward principal.key.id/principal.ip to ledger.record. Test max_usd_day=0 and zero-credit refusals without calling the hub.

residual_findings.finding: Colliding contribution slugs overwrite bytes behind an earlier passing proposal
residual_findings.trigger: The same account contributes concept A B with lint-passing output, then contributes A-B with lint-failing output while the first proposal is pending. Both concepts normalize to slug a-b.
residual_findings.observed: The actual contribution/moderation flows create two Artifact rows with the same path. The first stored lint verdict passes; the second contribution replaces the first bytes and its proposal is rejected by the actual linter. The first referenced bytes change from SHA256 7981381266c5eb949b37bd3ec367c11adcba914235ae4cddcc286ec04087d68a to 83f3b960ce28fed15071b3e01a01f84173f422d24dd9059ed805e7b9b6595b79. Actual moderation.decide marks the first proposal merged and reaches the mocked publication stage without rerunning lint.
residual_findings.consequence: An earlier proposal and artifact lose their reviewed content. Acceptance can rely on a passing verdict that describes different bytes from the current artifact, including bytes that the later gate rejected.
residual_findings.repair: Give every contribution an immutable artifact location and bind the lint verdict to the reviewed content hash. Verify that binding before acceptance; add a regression for colliding concepts and repeated pending contributions.
residual_findings.proof_limit: Only ordinary fixtures under the authorized proof directory were written. DB/provider/publication were fake. The real linter, apply_patch and validate_nodes ran; the actual public tree and configured user stores were not changed.
